This article compares the distribution of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (BMSL) treatments across two age groups: children and adolescents, and adults. The data highlights significant differences in treatment preferences and patient volumes between the demographics [^src1]. In total, the dataset records 360 unique pediatric patients and 10,163 adult patients receiving these therapies [^src1].

For children and adolescents, [[bohj18a1-behandling-med-infliximab|BOHJ18A1 - Behandling med infliximab]] is the overwhelmingly dominant leader, accounting for 239 patients, or 66% of the pediatric cohort [^src1]. The least used treatment (the trailer) in this group is [[bohj28d-behandling-med-tofacitinib|BOHJ28D - Behandling med tofacitinib]], with only 3 patients (1%) [^src1]. Notably, [[bohj18a4-behandling-med-golimumab|BOHJ18A4 - Behandling med golimumab]] records zero treatments for children and adolescents [^src1].

Among adults, [[bohj18a1-behandling-med-infliximab|BOHJ18A1 - Behandling med infliximab]] remains the leader, but its relative share is much lower, representing 3,754 patients (37%) [^src1]. The adult treatment landscape is more evenly distributed, with [[bohj18a3-behandling-med-adalimumab|BOHJ18A3 - Behandling med adalimumab]] following at 2,689 patients (26%), and both [[bohj19h4-behandling-med-vedolizumab|BOHJ19H4 - Behandling med vedolizumab]] and [[bohj18b3-behandling-med-ustekinumab|BOHJ18B3 - Behandling med ustekinumab]] capturing 17% and 16%, respectively [^src1]. As with the younger cohort, [[bohj28d-behandling-med-tofacitinib|BOHJ28D - Behandling med tofacitinib]] is the trailer for adults, used by just 126 patients (1%) [^src1]. 

Because this comparison is based on a single dated section, no longitudinal trends regarding treatment shifts, improvements, or target achievements over time can be established. The primary outlier in the data is the stark contrast in infliximab reliance, which is nearly twice as prevalent proportionally among children compared to adults, whereas adult treatments are spread across a wider variety of biologics and targeted synthetic drugs.

Summary: Tabellen viser antal unikke patienter, der modtog hver type BMSL-behandling i perioden, og demonstrerer infliximab som den dominerende behandling blandt børn og den mest anvendte blandt voksne, mens tofacitinib er den mindst anvendte for begge aldersgrupper.
